title: Layout / wall campaign
slide_intent: Use repeated structure across adjacent messages so a viewer can connect separate claims as one campaign.
strategic_value: Alternating image and text panels can give DB’s improvement messages a recognizable public presence.
demonstration: A wall installation alternates photographs with light and dark message panels, arrows, DB marks and red Schwellen.
practical_value: Compare how image, headline and identity elements retain their roles across neighboring panels.

content_islands.name: Campaign sequence
content_islands.spec: Arrange photographs and message panels as one continuous wall composition.

content_islands.name: Directional accents
content_islands.spec: Use arrows and vertical or horizontal Schwellen to connect the panel rhythm.

reference_purposes.Application: The image shows the layout system applied to an architectural-scale campaign.
